title: Trend: underlined serif tabs, three bottom-ruled filter controls and a line chart on a panel with a dashed expected line and direct labels at the line ends
use: A time series with filters. --param active picks the underlined tab; seed and volatility shape three seeded series; the expected line is at 1.0.

theme.note: light (ivory #FAF9F5) or dark (#141413) ground; tile names and the tooltip keep their fixed inks

convention.note: intl (default, the measured lineage): green heat scale, rising green, falling coral; cn (红涨绿跌, Chinese markets): red heat scale from light to deep, rising red, falling green; the main series takes the deep step (red in cn) and the accent series takes the fall colour (green in cn)

volatility.note: the size of a day's move

caption.default: 示例数据 · 虚线为预期水平 1.0× · 每日收盘后更新

relations: Tabs serif 24 / 500 on a 36 gap, the active one ink with a 2 underline, the others #5E5D59, a 1 hairline under the row; controls 300 wide on a 340 pitch (a bold 13 label, an 18 value, a rule and a chevron).
The panel is 1408 x 478, radius 8; the plot is 1100 x 370 with 1 hairline gridlines at every whole value; end labels are pushed 28 apart so none touch, the expected line is labelled the same way.
decoration: The panel, gridlines, series lines, end dots, chevrons and underline are decoration; tick labels are real text.

provenance.corpus: market hotspot index explorer kit (examples/index-explorer-kit): our own original data page in the index-explorer grammar; every number is generated in the page and marked as sample data
provenance.experiment: styles/index-explorer/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The data page's tabs, filter row and country time view re-set as one trend card.
measured: Tabs serif 18 / 27.9 weight 500, the active one ink with a 2 px underline; selects 140 x 23 with a bottom rule; the 'Expected: 1' mark.
Template: labels never touch at any seed; checked at both sizes, light and dark.
